title: [Solved] Fail gdm login
body: I have GNOME 50. When I upgrade packages, GNOME goes to 51. After upgrading GNOME to 51, a problem accures. When I want to login with gdm, after I press ENTER after typing the pw, a black screen appears for some moments and it returns to gdm login screen!
